blocks.text: The 78th Emmy Awards, which recognizes excellence in television, are taking place Monday evening at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Here are the best looks from the 2026 Emmys red carpet.
Top fashion moments from television's biggest night
Taking place Monday evening at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, the 78th Emmy Awards are expected to be a memorable affair.
The event, which recognizes excellence in television, will be hosted by actor Mariska Hargitay.

The show will include a special musical tribute to Dolly Parton led by Reba McEntire and an in memoriam performance of Bridge Over Troubled Water by Noah Kahan. The ceremony will also celebrate the 30th anniversary of Buffy the Vampire Slayer and the 50th anniversary of Charlie’s Angels.

Some Emmys have already been handed out at the Creative Arts Emmys earlier this month, but the list of stars taking the stage tonight is quite impressive: Dan Levy, John Mulaney, Awkwafina, Shailene Woodley, Alan Cumming, Florence Pugh and Annie Murphy are just a few of the confirmed presenters.
Here are the best looks from tonight’s 2026 Emmys red carpet.
We will be updating this post throughout the evening, so check back regularly for more looks.
The Pitt actor Supriya Ganesh wore a pale blue gown with ruffle details and a sheer underlayer.
The Canadian chef and co-star/executive producer of The Bear wore a tailored brown-and-black tuxedo with a classic white shirt.
Former The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills star Rinna, who appears in Season 4 of Traitors, wore a sculptural, asymmetrical black gown by Lever Couture.
Truc Nguyen is a Toronto-based writer, editor and stylist. Follow her at @trucnguyen.
